rev:doctor.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Doctor in India
rev:doctor.summary: A comprehensive guide for students entering Class 11 to pursue a career in medicine through the NEET-UG and MBBS pathway.

steps.title: Choose Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB)
steps.detail: Enroll in the Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects. Maintain a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in PCB to remain eligible for medical entrance exams.
steps.requirement: Class 10 Board completion with strong foundation in science and mathematics.

steps.title: Clear the NEET-UG Entrance Exam
steps.detail: Prepare thoroughly for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG), which is mandatory for admission to all medical colleges in India. A high percentile is required to secure a seat in government medical colleges.
steps.requirement: Minimum age of 17 years by December 31 of the year of admission.

steps.title: Complete the MBBS Degree
steps.detail: Pursue the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree from a recognized medical college. The course spans 4.5 years divided into pre-clinical, para-clinical, and clinical phases with regular university exams.
steps.requirement: Successful qualification in NEET-UG and counseling allotment.

steps.title: Compulsory Rotatory Medical Internship (CRMI)
steps.detail: Complete a mandatory 1-year rotatory internship in various hospital departments to gain hands-on clinical experience and obtain permanent registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council.
steps.requirement: Successful completion of all MBBS professional exams.

steps.title: Licensure and Practice as a General Practitioner
steps.detail: Register with the medical council to legally practice as a general physician. Alternatively, you can prepare for the National Exit Test (NExT) for licensure and PG admissions.
steps.requirement: Completion of MBBS and internship.

steps.title: Clear NEET-PG for MD/MS
steps.detail: If you wish to specialize in a specific branch like surgery, pediatrics, or internal medicine, clear the NEET-PG exam and complete a 3-year postgraduate residency program.
steps.requirement: Completed MBBS degree and permanent registration.

rev:doctor.commonMistake: Neglecting NCERT textbooks in Physics and Chemistry while focusing solely on Biology and complex coaching modules for NEET preparation.

rev:software engineer.title: Software Engineer Roadmap
rev:software engineer.summary: Path from choosing the Science stream in Class 11 to securing a software engineering role in India via engineering degrees and technical upskilling.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCM)
steps.detail: Opt for Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) with Computer Science as an elective in your higher secondary education. A strong foundation in Mathematics is critical for logical thinking and cracking engineering entrance exams.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60% aggregate in Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Appear for Engineering Entrances
steps.detail: Focus heavily on JEE Main and JEE Advanced alongside state-level CETs (like MHT CET, COMEDK, KCET) or private university exams (BITS-SAT, VITEEE). These exams test your Physics, Chemistry, and Math concepts at an advanced level.
steps.requirement: Minimum 75% in Class 12 (for NITs/IIITs/IITs)

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor of Engineering (BE) program in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) or Information Technology (IT). Master core subjects like Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, and Database Management Systems.
steps.requirement: Valid score in JEE Main/Advanced or State/Private CETs

steps.title: Skill Development and DSA
steps.detail: Regularly practice Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) on platforms like LeetCode and Codeforces. Build full-stack projects, contribute to open-source repositories, and host your code on GitHub to showcase practical coding ability.
steps.requirement: Consistent daily coding practice

steps.title: Internships and Placement Preparation
steps.detail: Secure summer software engineering internships via on-campus placements or off-campus drives. Prepare rigorously for technical interview rounds including system design, aptitude, and HR behavioral assessments.
steps.requirement: Strong resume and a portfolio of deployed projects

steps.title: Secure Full-Time Software Engineer Role
steps.detail: Convert your internship into a full-time offer (PPO) or crack off-campus hiring drives for product-based companies, service-based MNCs, or fast-growing tech startups.
steps.requirement: B.Tech/B.E. degree completion with zero active backlogs

rev:software engineer.commonMistake: Focusing solely on college GPA while neglecting practical coding skills, data structures, and real-world project building, which are essential for cracking technical interviews.

rev:chartered accountant.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Chartered Accountant (CA)
rev:chartered accountant.summary: A structured pathway for Indian students starting from class 11 to clear the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) rigorous qualification process alongside graduation.

steps.title: Choose Commerce Stream
steps.detail: Opt for the Commerce stream with Accounts, Business Studies, Economics, and Mathematics/Applied Mathematics. Building a strong foundation in these subjects during high school makes the concepts in accountancy much easier to grasp later.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 10 board exams from a recognized board

steps.title: Register for CA Foundation
steps.detail: Register with the Board of Studies (BoS) of ICAI for the CA Foundation course after passing your Class 12 exams. You can appear for your first attempt in either June or December of that year.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass certificate

steps.title: Clear CA Foundation & Pursue B.Com
steps.detail: Successfully clear the CA Foundation exam while simultaneously enrolling in a regular or distance B.Com degree. A B.Com degree provides essential commerce knowledge and fulfills graduation criteria required by many employers later.
steps.requirement: Pass CA Foundation exam

steps.title: Clear CA Intermediate & IT/OC Training
steps.detail: Prepare for and clear both groups of the CA Intermediate exam. Upon clearing either or both groups, complete the mandatory Integrated Course on Information Technology and Soft Skills (ICITSS) before starting practical training.
steps.requirement: Pass CA Foundation or hold a relevant graduation/post-graduation degree (Direct Entry route)

steps.title: Two-Year Articleship (Practical Training)
steps.detail: Undergo a mandatory 2-year practical training period (articleship) under a practicing Chartered Accountant. This hands-on experience in auditing, taxation, and accounting is crucial for professional development.
steps.requirement: Pass CA Intermediate (both groups) and complete ICITSS training

steps.title: Pass CA Final & Advance IT/Management Training
steps.detail: Appear for the CA Final examination during the last 6 months of your articleship or after its completion. Concurrently complete Advanced ICITSS (Management and Communication Skills) training.
steps.requirement: Complete specified period of articleship

steps.title: Become a Member of ICAI
steps.detail: After passing the CA Final exams and completing all training requirements, apply for membership with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India to officially use the 'CA' prefix.
steps.requirement: Pass CA Final (both groups) and all training programs

rev:chartered accountant.commonMistake: Treating CA Foundation and Intermediate casually, and failing to balance regular college attendance with rigorous self-study and practical conceptual understanding required by ICAI.

rev:pilot.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Commercial Pilot in India
rev:pilot.summary: Navigate from subject selection in Class 11 to earning a Commercial Pilot License (CPL) through ground classes, flying school, and airline conversion.

steps.title: Choose Science with Physics and Mathematics
steps.detail: Enroll in the Science stream with mandatory Physics and Mathematics, as DGCA requires these subjects to issue a Commercial Pilot License (CPL). Maintain a strong academic foundation while preparing mentally for strict medical fitness standards.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% aggregate in Physics and Mathematics

steps.title: Class 2 Medical Examination
steps.detail: Undergo a DGCA-approved Class 2 medical examination as early as possible to ensure you have no disqualifying vision, hearing, or cardiovascular issues before investing heavily in training.
steps.requirement: Fit status from a DGCA-empanelled medical examiner

steps.title: Class 1 Medical & Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS)
steps.detail: Upgrade to a Class 1 medical certificate, which is mandatory for obtaining a CPL. Clear the CPSS exam (formerly Pilot Aptitude Test), which is a one-time lifetime test required for commercial pilots.
steps.requirement: Class 1 Medical clearance and passing CPSS

steps.title: Clear DGCA Theory Examinations
steps.detail: Join a DGCA-approved ground school to study Air Regulation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Navigation, Technical General, and Radio Telephony (RTR-A). Pass the computer-based exams conducted by the DGCA.
steps.requirement: Pass all DGCA theory papers

steps.title: Enroll in a Flying Approved Training Organisation (ATO)
steps.detail: Join an approved Flying Club or ATO in India or abroad to complete the mandatory 200 hours of flight training. This includes solo flying, cross-country navigation, and multi-engine rating to earn your CPL.
steps.requirement: Valid CPL with Multi-Engine and Instrument Ratings

steps.title: Type Rating and Airline Cadet Program/Direct Recruitment
steps.detail: Obtain a Type Rating for a specific commercial aircraft (like the Airbus A320 or Boeing 737) and secure an Airline Transport Pilot License (ATPL) theory clearance. Apply for airline job openings or cadet pilot programs to start as a Junior First Officer.
steps.requirement: CPL, Type Rating certificate, and English Language Proficiency (ELP Level 4+)

examsToWatch: Airline Specific Aptitude and Psychometric Tests
rev:pilot.commonMistake: Failing to check Class 1 and Class 2 medical fitness requirements before joining a flying school, leading to wasted financial investments if a disqualifying medical condition is found later.

rev:lawyer.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Lawyer in India
rev:lawyer.summary: Transition from high school to a professional legal career through integrated law degrees and national entrance examinations.

steps.title: Choose Stream and Build Foundation
steps.detail: Select any stream (Arts, Commerce, or Science) as there is no stream restriction for law. Focus on developing strong English reading comprehension, logical reasoning, and general awareness alongside board exam preparation.
steps.requirement: Minimum 45% to 50% aggregate in Class 12 board exams depending on the university

steps.title: Appear for Law Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Register and appear for premier law entrance tests like CLAT, AILET, or various state and private university CETs right after completing Class 12.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass certificate or appearance in board exams

steps.title: Pursue Integrated B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) or B.B.A. LL.B.
steps.detail: Enroll in a 5-year integrated undergraduate law program at a National Law University (NLU) or a reputed private law school. The curriculum combines general humanities/management subjects with core legal education like constitutional law, contracts, and criminal law.
steps.requirement: Qualifying score in CLAT/AILET and completion of Class 12

steps.title: Internships and Moot Courts
steps.detail: Gain practical exposure by interning under trial court advocates, corporate law firms, NGOs, or judges during semester breaks. Participate actively in moot court competitions to hone advocacy and drafting skills.
steps.requirement: Good academic standing in law school

steps.title: Enroll with State Bar Council
steps.detail: Obtain your law degree (LL.B.) and register with your respective State Bar Council as an advocate to legally practice in Indian courts.
steps.requirement: Completed 5-year LL.B. degree

steps.title: Clear AIBE and Begin Practice
steps.detail: Clear the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) within two years of enrollment to receive the Certificate of Practice. Start practicing independently or join a senior advocate or law firm as a junior associate.
steps.requirement: State Bar Council Enrollment

rev:lawyer.commonMistake: Ignoring the importance of serious preparation for entrance exams like CLAT and treating law simply as a backup option, which reduces chances of entering top-tier National Law Universities.

rev:fashion designer.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Fashion Designer
rev:fashion designer.summary: A structured pathway from choosing the right higher secondary stream to earning a design degree and entering the fashion industry.

steps.title: Choose Any Stream with Creative Focus
steps.detail: Opt for any stream—Arts, Commerce, or Science—based on your comfort, but focus heavily on sketching, observation, and creative arts. Building a habit of maintaining a sketchbook and staying aware of trends and textiles is crucial.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Prepare for National Design Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Start preparing for premier design entrance tests like NIFT (National Institute of Fashion Technology) and NID (National Institute of Design). Focus on quantitative ability, communication, English, and creative/analytical drawing skills.
steps.requirement: Enrolled in or completed Class 12 from a recognized board

steps.title: Crack Entrance Exams and Secure Admission
steps.detail: Clear the written tests (CAT and GAT for NIFT) followed by situation tests or studio tests and personal interviews. Secure admission into a Bachelor of Design (B.Des) in Fashion Design program.
steps.requirement: Qualify NIFT/NID/UCEED entrance exams

steps.title: Pursue Bachelor of Design (B.Des) in Fashion
steps.detail: Spend 4 years mastering garment construction, textile science, fashion illustration, computer-aided design (CAD), and draping. Participate in college fashion shows, craft cluster initiatives, and design competitions to build your portfolio.
steps.requirement: Successful completion of previous academic semesters

steps.title: Mandatory Industry Internship & Graduation Project
steps.detail: Undertake a 3 to 6-month internship with an established export house, designer label, or retail brand. Complete a final graduation collection showcasing your unique design aesthetic and technical execution.
steps.requirement: Enrolled in the final year of B.Des

steps.title: Enter the Workforce as a Designer or Stylist
steps.detail: Start working as an Assistant Designer, Fashion Stylist, or Merchandiser under senior designers or corporate retail brands. Gaining 2-3 years of floor experience helps you understand production, sourcing, and consumer behavior.
steps.requirement: B.Des degree and a strong portfolio

rev:fashion designer.commonMistake: Focusing solely on artistic sketching while ignoring garment construction, textile science, and the business side of fashion.

rev:ias officer.title: Roadmap to IAS Officer
rev:ias officer.summary: A comprehensive journey from selecting the right 11th stream to clearing the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Civil Services Examination.

steps.title: Choose Humanities/Arts Stream
steps.detail: Opt for subjects like History, Political Science, Geography, and Economics. This builds a strong foundational knowledge base directly relevant to the UPSC Civil Services syllabus.
steps.requirement: Complete Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Earn Any Bachelor's Degree
steps.detail: Enroll in a 3 or 4-year graduation program (BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, etc.) in any discipline from a recognized university. Utilize these years to build reading habits, current affairs awareness, and analytical skills.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 12 board exams

steps.title: Begin UPSC Preparation and NCERTs
steps.detail: Start reading standard NCERT textbooks from Class 6 to 12 to build fundamental concepts. Read a daily national newspaper like The Hindu or The Indian Express regularly.
steps.requirement: Currently enrolled in college

steps.title: Appear for UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Exam
steps.detail: Register and clear the Civil Services Prelims, which consists of two objective papers: General Studies Paper I and CSAT. You must be at least 21 years old to appear.
steps.requirement: Minimum age of 21 years and a Bachelor's degree

steps.title: Clear UPSC Civil Services Main Exam
steps.detail: Write the descriptive Main examination comprising 9 papers, including an Essay, General Studies papers I-IV, and an optional subject of your choice.
steps.requirement: Qualify the UPSC Prelims exam

steps.title: Personality Test (Interview) and Training
steps.detail: Attend the UPSC board interview to assess mental alertness and leadership traits. Upon clearing, join Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration (LBSNAA) for rigorous civil services training.
steps.requirement: Qualify the UPSC Mains exam

rev:ias officer.commonMistake: Delaying newspaper reading and current affairs notes until after graduation, which makes covering the vast syllabus of General Studies overwhelming.

rev:data scientist.title: Data Scientist Career Roadmap
rev:data scientist.summary: A comprehensive guide for Indian students to transition from high school stream selection to becoming a professional data scientist.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream with Mathematics
steps.detail: Opt for the Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM), along with Computer Science or Statistics if available. Strong fundamentals in calculus, algebra, and probability are absolute prerequisites for data science.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60% aggregate in Class 10

steps.title: Crack Engineering or Science Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Prepare for national and state-level exams like JEE Main, JEE Advanced, or CUET to secure admission into top-tier institutions offering relevant bachelor's degrees.
steps.requirement: Class 12 board exams with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech, BCA, or B.Sc in Quantitative Fields
steps.detail: Enroll in a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science, or a B.Sc/B.Stat in Statistics or Mathematics. Focus heavily on programming, data structures, and database management.
steps.requirement: Valid score in JEE Main/Advanced or CUET

steps.title: Master Python, SQL, and Machine Learning
steps.detail: Learn core data science libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow), build real-world projects on GitHub, and secure internships focusing on data analysis or software engineering.
steps.requirement: Proficiency in Python and basic statistics

steps.title: Pursue M.Tech or M.Sc in Data Science / AI
steps.detail: Clear entrance exams like GATE (for M.Tech) or university-specific tests to pursue a master's degree for advanced roles, deep learning specialization, and better placement opportunities.
steps.requirement: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline

steps.title: Secure Entry-Level Roles as Data Analyst or Junior Data Scientist
steps.detail: Apply for roles such as Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Junior Machine Learning Engineer to gain industry experience in model deployment, data cleaning, and business communication.
steps.requirement: Strong portfolio of data science projects and problem-solving skills

examsToWatch: GATE (Data Science and Artificial Intelligence - DA)
rev:data scientist.commonMistake: Focusing solely on theory and machine learning algorithms without building a strong foundation in core mathematics (linear algebra, calculus, and probability) and practical programming skills like SQL and Python.

rev:architect.title: Roadmap to Becoming an Architect in India
rev:architect.summary: This career path requires choosing the Science stream with Mathematics in Class 11, clearing national-level architecture entrance exams, and completing a 5-year B.Arch degree.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream with Mathematics
steps.detail: Opt for Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) in your 11th grade under CBSE, ICSE, or state boards. Mathematics is a mandatory regulatory requirement set by the Council of Architecture (COA) for pursuing an architecture degree in India.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, as well as overall in Class 12.

steps.title: Appear for Board Exams and Prep for Entrance Tests
steps.detail: Focus on scoring well in your board exams while simultaneously starting preparation for national-level architecture aptitude tests. Practice sketching, spatial visualization, and logical reasoning alongside your PCM studies.
steps.requirement: Must pass Class 12 board exams with PCM.

steps.title: Crack NATA or JEE Main Paper 2
steps.detail: Register and appear for NATA (National Aptitude Test in Architecture) conducted by COA and/or JEE Main Paper 2 (B.Arch) conducted by NTA. These scores are the primary criteria for admission into top architecture colleges like IITs, NITs, and SPA.
steps.requirement: Valid score in NATA and/or JEE Main Paper 2.

steps.title: Complete the 5-Year B.Arch Program
steps.detail: Enroll in a Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) degree approved by the Council of Architecture. The rigorous 10-semester curriculum covers architectural design, building construction, structural engineering, history of architecture, and computer-aided design (CAD).
steps.requirement: Admission through JoSAA counseling (for IITs/NITs) or state/institute-level counseling based on entrance scores.

steps.title: Undertake Mandatory Internship
steps.detail: Complete a compulsory practical training period, usually spanning 6 months to a year during the later semesters of the B.Arch program. Work under a registered senior architect to gain hands-on experience in site execution, client handling, and drafting.
steps.requirement: Enrollment in a recognized B.Arch program reaching the internship semester.

steps.title: Register with the Council of Architecture (COA)
steps.detail: Upon successful graduation with a B.Arch degree, apply for registration with the Council of Architecture (COA). Obtaining this professional license is legally mandatory to practice architecture, sign building plans, and use the title 'Architect' in India.
steps.requirement: Graduation degree certificate from a COA-approved institution.

examsToWatch: JEE Advanced (for B.Arch at IIT Kharagpur, IIT Roorkee, and IIT BHU)
rev:architect.commonMistake: Choosing the Biology/PCB group or Commerce/Arts in Class 11 without Mathematics, which legally disqualifies the student from appearing for NATA and JEE Paper 2 under Council of Architecture norms.

rev:psychologist.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Psychologist in India
rev:psychologist.summary: A comprehensive guide starting from stream selection in Class 11 to earning a Master's degree and registering as a qualified psychologist in India.

steps.title: Choose Humanities/Arts with Psychology
steps.detail: Select the Humanities (Arts) stream and ensure Psychology is one of your core subjects if available by your board. A science background (PCB) is also acceptable, but humanities builds a strong theoretical foundation.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 10 board exams with a good aggregate percentage.

steps.title: Complete a 3 or 4-year Bachelor's Degree
steps.detail: Pursue a BA or BSc in Psychology from a recognized university to understand core psychological concepts, human behavior, and research methods. Opt for the 4-year undergraduate research degree if aligned with the new National Education Policy (NEP).
steps.requirement: Clear Class 12 board exams and university-specific entrance tests like CUET.

steps.title: Pursue a Master's Degree in Specialized Field
steps.detail: Enroll in a 2-year Master's program in Psychology (Clinical, Counseling, Organizational, or Applied Psychology). This is mandatory for advanced practice and specialization.
steps.requirement: Complete Bachelor's degree with minimum 50-55% aggregate and clear entrance exams like CUET-PG or institute-specific tests.

steps.title: M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or Professional Diploma
steps.detail: If you want to practice as a Clinical Psychologist and diagnose mental disorders, complete an RCI-recognized M.Phil in Clinical Psychology (being phased out into specific professional tracks under new guidelines) or a PsyD.
steps.requirement: Hold an MA/MSc in Psychology and clear the rigorous RCI-affiliated entrance examinations and interviews.

steps.title: RCI Registration & Internship
steps.detail: Register with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) if pursuing clinical psychology, or obtain professional memberships for counseling. Gain supervised practical experience through internships in hospitals, clinics, or schools.
steps.requirement: Completion of M.Phil/Professional Diploma and mandatory supervised clinical hours.

examsToWatch: CUET (Central Universities Entrance Test) for UG & PG
RCI-approved Entrance Exams for M.Phil Clinical Psychology
University-specific entrance tests like TISSMAT, Christ University Entrance Test
rev:psychologist.commonMistake: Stopping at a Bachelor's degree and expecting to practice clinically or counsel professionally, when a Master's degree and proper supervised training are legally and ethically required in India.

rev:teacher.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Teacher in India
rev:teacher.summary: A comprehensive guide starting from stream selection in Class 11 to completing professional teaching qualifications for schools or higher education.

steps.title: Choose Stream and Complete Senior Secondary
steps.detail: Choose any stream (Arts, Science, or Commerce) based on your preferred teaching subject. Score a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in your 12th board exams, which is a mandatory requirement for most teacher training programs and universities.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% in Class 12 Boards

steps.title: Pursue a Bachelor's Degree (BA, B.Sc, or B.Com)
steps.detail: Complete a 3 or 4-year undergraduate degree in the specific subject you intend to teach in the future. Building a strong conceptual foundation in your chosen major subject is critical for clearing teacher eligibility tests later.
steps.requirement: Passed Class 12

steps.title: Alternative: Integrated B.Ed (BA-B.Ed / B.Sc-B.Ed)
steps.detail: Instead of a regular graduation followed by B.Ed, students can directly enroll in a 4-year Integrated Teacher Education Program (ITEP) right after Class 12. This saves a year and combines disciplinary knowledge with pedagogical training.
steps.requirement: Class 12 with 50% + State/National Entrance Tests

steps.title: Pursue Bachelor of Education (B.Ed)
steps.detail: After completing your graduation, enroll in a 2-year B.Ed degree program to learn child psychology, classroom management, and modern pedagogical techniques. Admission is typically based on graduation marks or state-level B.Ed entrance exams.
steps.requirement: Undergraduate Degree with minimum 50-55%

steps.title: Clear TET (Teacher Eligibility Test)
steps.detail: Qualify the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) or your respective State Teacher Eligibility Test (State TET). Passing TET is a mandatory statutory requirement to become eligible for teaching positions in government and recognized private schools.
steps.requirement: B.Ed or D.El.Ed qualification

steps.title: Secure Teaching Position or Pursue Post-Graduation
steps.detail: Apply for teaching jobs in schools through recruitment exams like KVS, NVS, DSSSB, or state public service commissions. If aiming to teach in colleges or universities, pursue a Master's degree followed by clearing the UGC-NET exam and completing a Ph.D.
steps.requirement: TET cleared / Master's + UGC-NET for college level

rev:teacher.commonMistake: Focusing solely on completing the graduation degree while ignoring the mandatory requirement of securing at least 50% marks, which creates eligibility roadblocks for admission into B.Ed programs.

rev:graphic designer.title: Graphic Designer Roadmap
rev:graphic designer.summary: A comprehensive guide for Indian students to transition from high school stream selection to a professional graphic design career.

steps.title: Choose Stream (Any Stream - Arts Preferred) & Build Foundations
steps.detail: Opt for any stream in your 11th grade, though Arts or Humanities with subjects like Fine Arts is beneficial. Focus on developing sketching skills, visual aesthetics, and basic computer literacy while maintaining good board exam percentages.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 12 from any recognized board (CBSE/ICSE/State) with a minimum of 50% aggregate.

steps.title: Prepare and Appear for Design Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Start preparing for national and state-level design entrance tests during Class 11 and 12. Focus on creative aptitude, logical reasoning, visualization, and general awareness.
steps.requirement: Register and appear for exams like NID DAT, UCEED, NIFT, or private university tests (MITID, Srishti, UID).

steps.title: Pursue a Bachelor of Design (B.Des) in Communication Design
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year professional B.Des program specializing in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or Animation. Learn industry-standard software (Adobe Creative Suite), typography, color theory, branding, and user interface basics.
steps.requirement: Clear the respective entrance exam and complete counseling for seat allotment.

steps.title: Build a Portfolio and Undertake Internships
steps.detail: Create a robust design portfolio showcasing real-world projects, brand identities, packaging, and digital illustrations. Secure a 2-3 month summer internship at a design agency, media house, or corporate marketing department to gain practical experience.
steps.requirement: Successful completion of academic semesters and submission of a graduation design project.

steps.title: Secure Junior Graphic Designer Role or Freelance
steps.detail: Apply for Junior Graphic Designer positions in advertising agencies, design studios, tech companies, or start working as an independent freelancer. Continuously update your portfolio with new trends in motion graphics and UI/UX.
steps.requirement: A polished digital portfolio (Behance/Dribbble) and a professional resume.

examsToWatch: UCEED (Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design)
rev:graphic designer.commonMistake: Focusing solely on software proficiency (like Photoshop or Illustrator) while neglecting fundamental design principles, typography, sketching, and building a strong creative portfolio.

rev:civil engineer.title: Civil Engineer Roadmap in India
rev:civil engineer.summary: This roadmap guides a student from choosing the right stream after Class 10 to completing their engineering degree and starting a career as a civil engineer in India.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCM)
steps.detail: Select Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) along with English. A strong foundation in these subjects is mandatory for engineering entrance exams and the core engineering curriculum.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50-60% aggregate in Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Appear for Engineering Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Prepare for and clear national and state-level engineering entrance tests like JEE Main, JEE Advanced (for IITs), BITSAT, or respective State CETs to secure admission into top engineering colleges.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) program in Civil Engineering. Focus on core subjects like structural analysis, fluid mechanics, surveying, and geotechnical engineering while securing internships.
steps.requirement: Valid score in JEE Main/State CET/College specific entrance test

steps.title: Gain Practical Experience or Opt for M.Tech
steps.detail: Complete mandatory industrial training during the degree. Alternatively, prepare for GATE if you wish to pursue a 2-year M.Tech specialization (such as Structural Engineering or Transportation Engineering) or secure Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) jobs.
steps.requirement: B.Tech/B.E. degree in Civil Engineering

steps.title: Secure Employment & Professional Licensing
steps.detail: Join construction firms, real estate developers, consulting companies, or government bodies (via UPSC Engineering Services or State PSCs) as a Graduate Engineer Trainee or Junior Engineer. Register with relevant engineering bodies if required for specific statutory roles.
steps.requirement: B.Tech degree and clearing competitive exams like ESE/GATE if aiming for government sector

examsToWatch: State CETs (MHT CET, KCET, WBJEE, etc.)
rev:civil engineer.commonMistake: Neglecting practical site exposure, software skills (AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, Revit), and internships during the B.Tech degree, relying solely on theoretical textbook knowledge.

rev:nurse.title: Nursing Career Roadmap in India
rev:nurse.summary: A comprehensive guide for students aiming to become a Registered Nurse in India, starting from subject selection in Class 11 through degree completion and licensure.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCB)
steps.detail: Select the Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) along with English, as Biology is a mandatory requirement for nursing courses in India. Aim to score at least 45% to 50 aggregate marks in your 12th board exams to meet basic eligibility criteria for entrance exams.
steps.requirement: Minimum 45-50% aggregate in 12th PCB

steps.title: Appear for Nursing Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Register and appear for national or state-level nursing entrance exams like NEET-UG (accepted by many top institutions), AIIMS Nursing entrance exam, or respective state CETs for B.Sc. Nursing admissions.
steps.requirement: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English in Class 12

steps.title: Pursue B.Sc. Nursing Degree
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Nursing program approved by the Indian Nursing Council (INC). This rigorous course combines foundational medical sciences, nursing theory, and extensive clinical practice in hospitals.
steps.requirement: Qualified nursing entrance exam or merit in 12th

steps.title: Complete Mandatory Internship
steps.detail: Complete the mandatory clinical internship period integrated into the final year of the B.Sc. Nursing curriculum across various hospital departments like ICU, pediatrics, and surgery.
steps.requirement: Successful completion of final year B.Sc. exams

steps.title: Register with State Nursing Council
steps.detail: Register your nursing degree with your respective State Nursing Council to legally practice as a Registered Nurse and Midwife (RN/RM) in India.
steps.requirement: Degree certificate from an INC-approved institution

steps.title: Begin Employment or Specialize
steps.detail: Start working as a staff nurse in government or private hospitals to gain hands-on experience, or prepare for the M.Sc. Nursing entrance exam after 1-2 years of clinical experience if you wish to specialize.
steps.requirement: Valid State Nursing Council Registration

examsToWatch: State Nursing CETs (e.g., KCET, MHT-CET, RUHS Nursing)
rev:nurse.commonMistake: Choosing a nursing college that is not officially recognized by the Indian Nursing Council (INC) or State Nursing Council, which makes the graduate ineligible to register for professional practice.

rev:journalist.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Journalist in India
rev:journalist.summary: Navigate from high school subject selection through media entrance exams and bachelor's degrees to entry-level reporting roles in Indian media.

steps.title: Choose Humanities/Arts Stream
steps.detail: Opt for subjects like English, Political Science, History, and Sociology to build a strong foundation in current affairs, language proficiency, and socio-political awareness. Alternatively, Commerce or Science students are also eligible, but Arts offers the best conceptual grounding.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50-60% aggregate in Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Prepare for Media Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Focus on scoring well in your board exams while simultaneously preparing for mass communication entrance tests. Read English and regional newspapers daily, stay updated on current affairs, and practice creative writing and basic logical reasoning.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 12 from any recognized board (CBSE/ICSE/State)

steps.title: Pursue Bachelor's in Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC/BA in Journalism)
steps.detail: Clear university-specific or national entrance tests like CUET, IIMC entrance, or GGSIPU CET. Enroll in a 3 or 4-year undergraduate degree program that teaches reporting, editing, media ethics, and audio-visual production.
steps.requirement: CUET, IIMC Entrance Exam, or individual college tests (e.g., XIC, Symbiosis SET)

steps.title: Internships and Student Media
steps.detail: Gain practical exposure by working as an intern for digital news portals, newspapers, or local TV channels. Write articles, help with video editing, build a portfolio of published work, and contribute to college magazines.
steps.requirement: Proactive outreach and basic multimedia writing skills

steps.title: Master's Degree or Specialized Training
steps.detail: Consider a PG Diploma in Journalism from institutes like IIMC, Asian College of Journalism (ACJ), or XIC for high-tier industry connections and intensive practical training, though a direct entry into the job market is also common.
steps.requirement: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% marks

steps.title: Entry-Level Trainee Journalist or Reporter
steps.detail: Start as a Trainee Reporter, Sub-Editor, or Digital Content Producer at news agencies, print houses, or broadcast channels. Focus on building sources, mastering fact-checking, and adapting to fast-paced newsroom deadlines.
steps.requirement: Strong news sense, flawless writing skills, and a portfolio

rev:journalist.commonMistake: Treating journalism purely as a glamorous TV job while ignoring the immense importance of print reading, rigorous fact-checking, and strong grammar.

rev:chef.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Chef in India
rev:chef.summary: A comprehensive guide starting from stream selection after 10th grade to culinary school, training, and entering the professional kitchen hierarchy.

steps.title: Choose Any Stream (Arts, Commerce, or Science)
steps.detail: Colleges offering hospitality and hotel management accept students from any recognized stream. Focus on scoring good aggregate marks in board exams and building good communication skills, as the hospitality industry values interpersonal abilities.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 12 with minimum 50% aggregate from CBSE, ICSE, or State Board.

steps.title: Appear for Hotel Management Entrance Tests
steps.detail: Prepare for national and state-level entrance exams for hotel management. The most prominent is NCHMCT JEE for admission to premier Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) campuses across India. Other options include MAHCET HM CET and university-specific tests.
steps.requirement: NCHMCT JEE or equivalent state/institutional entrance exam.

steps.title: Pursue B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration
steps.detail: Enroll in a reputed degree program such as the B.Sc. in HHA offered by NCHMCT-affiliated IHMs or a Bachelor in Culinary Arts (BCA). This provides rigorous foundational training in food production, bakery, pastry, nutrition, and kitchen operations.
steps.requirement: Qualify entrance exam and secure admission in an IHM or recognized private culinary college.

steps.title: Complete Industrial Training in 5-Star Hotels
steps.detail: Utilize the mandatory industrial training semester during your degree to work in the kitchens of major hotel chains like Taj, Oberoi, Marriott, or ITC. This hands-on exposure is critical for understanding high-pressure commercial kitchen environments.
steps.requirement: Enrolled in 2nd or 3rd year of hotel management degree.

steps.title: Join as a Commis or Kitchen Trainee
steps.detail: Start your career at the bottom of the kitchen brigade as a Commis (Commis III, II, and I) in luxury hotels, fine dining restaurants, or cruise lines. Expect long hours, repetitive prep work, and intense physical labor to master foundational techniques.
steps.requirement: Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management or Culinary Arts.

steps.title: Advance to Chef de Partie and Sous Chef
steps.detail: Specialize in a cuisine or section such as Garde Manger, Patisserie, or Hot Kitchen. With 5 to 10 years of experience, you can promote to Sous Chef and eventually Executive Chef, managing kitchen budgets, menu creation, and staff operations.
steps.requirement: Consistent performance, advanced culinary skill development, and leadership experience.

rev:chef.commonMistake: Treating hotel management purely as a glamorous cooking show experience without realizing that entry-level kitchen jobs demand years of grueling physical labor, odd shifts, and repetitive prep work before ever getting to design menus.

rev:merchant navy officer.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Merchant Navy Officer in India
rev:merchant navy officer.summary: Navigate from high school stream selection to joining the merchant navy as a deck cadet or marine engineer through recognized maritime degrees and sponsor companies.

steps.title: Choose Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM)
steps.detail: Enroll in the Science stream with mandatory PCM and English, scoring at least 60% aggregate marks in 12th boards and minimum 50% in English. Strong fundamentals in physics and math are absolute prerequisites for all DG Shipping-approved marine engineering and nautical science courses.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60% in PCM and 50% in English

steps.title: Clear IMU-CET and Company Sponsorship
steps.detail: Appear for the Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test (IMU-CET). Concurrently, apply for sponsorships from top shipping companies like Anglo-Eastern, Maersk, or Fleet Management, as company sponsorship significantly eases placement and is often required by premier institutes.
steps.requirement: IMU-CET qualification and valid medical fitness (DG Shipping standards)

steps.title: Pursue B.Sc. Nautical Science or B.Tech Marine Engineering
steps.detail: Complete a 3-year B.Sc. in Nautical Science (for deck side) or a 4-year B.Tech in Marine Engineering (for engine side) from a DG Shipping-approved maritime institute like IMU campuses, Tolani, or AMET.
steps.requirement: Pass semester exams and undergo mandatory STCW safety training courses

steps.title: Complete Pre-Sea Training and Obtain CDC
steps.detail: Finish your college curriculum along with mandatory STCW (Standard of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping) basic safety courses. Obtain your Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) and Indian passport.
steps.requirement: Degree completion, STCW certificates, CDC, and Passport

steps.title: Join as a Deck or Engine Cadet
steps.detail: Board merchant vessels to complete 12 to 18 months of structured sea-service training. Maintain a Cadet Record Book, learning practical operations, navigation, or engine maintenance under senior officers.
steps.requirement: Valid STCW certifications and medical clearance

steps.title: Clear Mates/2nd Engineer Competency Exams
steps.detail: After completing the required sea time, return ashore to clear the written and oral competency examinations conducted by the Directorate General of Shipping (MMD exams) to earn your Second Mate or MEO Class IV certificate of competency.
steps.requirement: Required sea-time months and passed MMD written/oral exams

steps.title: Ascend to Captain or Chief Engineer
steps.detail: Sail further, gain experience, and clear progressively higher grade certification exams (Chief Mate, Master / MEO Class II, MEO Class III) to eventually command the ship as a Captain or Chief Engineer.
steps.requirement: Accumulated sea service and advanced MMD competency certificates

rev:merchant navy officer.commonMistake: Enrolling in non-DG Shipping approved maritime colleges that promise placements, which leads to degrees unrecognized internationally and inability to obtain a valid CDC or Indian seaman book.

rev:army officer.title: Roadmap to Becoming an Indian Army Officer
rev:army officer.summary: Guide for an Indian student starting from Class 11 to join the Indian Army as a commissioned officer via NDA, CDS, or direct entries.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCM)
steps.detail: Opt for Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM). Mathematics is mandatory if you wish to apply for the National Defence Academy (NDA) via the Army/Navy/Air Force technical entries, though humanities or commerce students can also apply for the Army wing of NDA.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% aggregate in Class 12 for NDA.

steps.title: Appear for NDA & NA Examination (I)
steps.detail: Apply and appear for the UPSC National Defence Academy exam while in Class 12 or immediately after passing. The exam tests Mathematics and General Ability Test (GAT).
steps.requirement: Unmarried male/female candidates aged 16.5 to 19.5 years.

steps.title: Clear the Services Selection Board (SSB)
steps.detail: If you clear the written NDA exam, you will undergo a rigorous 5-day SSB interview testing intelligence, personality, psychology, and physical fitness, followed by a medical examination.
steps.requirement: Recommendation by SSB Board and medical fitness.

steps.title: Join NDA or Pursue Graduation
steps.detail: If selected in NDA, undergo 3 years of joint training at Khadakwasla, Pune, followed by 1 year at IMA, Dehradun, leading to a graduation degree. If not selected, complete a 3 or 4-year graduation degree from a recognized university.
steps.requirement: Graduation degree in any discipline for CDS entry later.

steps.title: Appear for CDS Examination
steps.detail: Write the Combined Defence Services (CDS) examination conducted by UPSC for Permanent Commission through Indian Military Academy (IMA) / Officers Training Academy (OTA).
steps.requirement: Final year graduation students or graduates aged 19 to 24 years.

steps.title: SSB & Training at IMA / OTA
steps.detail: Clear the CDS SSB interview and medicals, then join the Indian Military Academy (IMA Dehradun) for Permanent Commission or Officers Training Academy (OTA Chennai) for Short Service Commission for 18 to 49 months of intensive military training.
steps.requirement: Successful completion of SSB and merit list placement.

steps.title: Commissioned as Lieutenant
steps.detail: Upon successful passing out from the academy, you are commissioned into the Indian Army as a Lieutenant and begin your active military career.
steps.requirement: Successful passing out parade at IMA or OTA.

rev:army officer.commonMistake: Neglecting physical fitness and English communication skills early on, assuming that clearing only the UPSC written exam is enough to secure a recommendation at the SSB interview.

rev:pharmacist.title: Roadmap to Becoming a Pharmacist in India
rev:pharmacist.summary: Guide from selecting the right high school stream to completing graduation and getting licensed to practice pharmacy in India.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCB or PCM)
steps.detail: Enroll in Class 11 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) or Mathematics (PCM). Biology is generally preferred and often mandatory for pharmacy admissions in many states.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% aggregate marks in 12th board exams with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Maths.

steps.title: Appear for Pharmacy Entrance Tests
steps.detail: Prepare for and clear national or state-level pharmacy entrance tests such as NEET UG (accepted by many colleges), CUET, or state-specific CETs like MHT-CET, WBJEE, or GUJCET.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass or appearing.

steps.title: Pursue Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm)
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year undergraduate B.Pharm program approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). This comprehensive course covers pharmaceutics, pharmacology, pharmaceutical chemistry, and pharmacognosy.
steps.requirement: Qualified entrance exam score and 10+2 Science completion.

steps.title: Alternative: Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm)
steps.detail: If you wish to start practicing sooner, you can opt for a 2-year D.Pharm course, which is sufficient to open a retail medical store or work as a registered pharmacist.
steps.requirement: Class 12 Science pass.

steps.title: Industrial Training and State Pharmacy Council Registration
steps.detail: Complete the mandatory practical training period included in your degree/diploma, and register with your respective State Pharmacy Council to obtain your license to practice.
steps.requirement: Completed B.Pharm or D.Pharm degree.

steps.title: Master's Degree (M.Pharm) or Specialization
steps.detail: Clear the GPAT exam to pursue a 2-year M.Pharm for specialization in areas like Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, or Quality Assurance, opening doors to research and senior industry roles.
steps.requirement: B.Pharm degree and valid GPAT score.

rev:pharmacist.commonMistake: Enrolling in a pharmacy college that is not officially approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), which disqualifies you from getting a state pharmacist license.

rev:interior designer.title: Roadmap to Becoming an Interior Designer in India
rev:interior designer.summary: This path guides a student from choosing the right high school stream to completing professional design education and entering the interior design industry.

steps.title: Choose Any Stream with a Focus on Creativity
steps.detail: Select Science, Commerce, or Arts based on personal strength; Science (PCM) helps with spatial technicalities, while Arts or Commerce works equally well. Focus on developing drawing skills, spatial awareness, and a keen eye for aesthetics alongside board exam preparation.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% aggregate in Class 12 from any recognized board (CBSE/ICSE/State).

steps.title: Prepare and Appear for Design Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Register and prepare for national and institutional design entrance tests such as NID DAT, UCEED, NIFT, or specific private university design tests. Focus on aptitude, logical reasoning, sketching, and creative problem-solving.
steps.requirement: Eligibility to apply for undergraduate design entrance examinations.

steps.title: Pursue B.Des or B.Sc in Interior Design
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year Bachelor of Design (B.Des) in Interior Design or Architecture/Interior Space Design at a reputed institute like NID, CEPT, NIFT, or top private universities. The curriculum covers material science, CAD software, ergonomics, color theory, and studio projects.
steps.requirement: Qualifying entrance exam scores and Class 12 pass certificate.

steps.title: Internship and Portfolio Development
steps.detail: Secure a mandatory summer or semester-long internship with established interior design firms, architecture studios, or real estate developers. Build a comprehensive professional portfolio showcasing design concepts, 3D renderings, and execution drawings.
steps.requirement: Completion of core academic modules and design studio projects.

steps.title: Junior Interior Designer or Specialization
steps.detail: Join an interior design firm as a Junior Designer to learn client handling, vendor management, estimation, and site execution. Alternatively, some graduates choose a 2-year Master of Design (M.Des) to specialize in sustainable design or lighting.
steps.requirement: Bachelor's degree in Interior Design and a strong creative portfolio.

steps.title: Establish Independent Practice or Senior Designer Role
steps.detail: After gaining 3-5 years of industry experience and building a robust network of contractors, carpenters, and vendors, you can register your own design studio or take up independent turnkey residential and commercial projects.
steps.requirement: Industry experience, professional network, and IIID (Institute of Indian Interior Designers) membership recommended.

examsToWatch: NID DAT (National Institute of Design - Design Aptitude Test)
UCEED (Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design)
NATA / JEE Main Paper 2 (if opting for Interior Architecture tracks)
AIEED, Pearl Academy, and other private university entrance tests
rev:interior designer.commonMistake: Focusing solely on artistic sketching while ignoring technical software (like AutoCAD, 3ds Max, Revit) and the practical aspects of material science and on-site vendor management.

fwd:10th:any.title: Science Stream with PCM (Engineering & Technology)
fwd:10th:any.summary: Choosing the Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) keeps the maximum number of doors open in the Indian education system, particularly for engineering, technology, and pure sciences.

steps.title: Choose PCM with Computer Science or Economics
steps.detail: Focus heavily on mastering core concepts in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics while maintaining a strong overall aggregate in your board exams. Build a solid foundation early as this forms the base for all major engineering entrance examinations.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60% aggregate in Class 10

steps.title: Clear Class 12 Boards
steps.detail: Secure competitive board percentages, keeping in mind that many premier engineering institutions and entrance tests require a minimum aggregate of 75% in Class 12.
steps.requirement: Minimum 75% aggregate for NITs/IIITs/CFTIs eligibility

steps.title: Begin Competitive Exam Preparation
steps.detail: Enroll in a coaching program or self-study using standard reference books for national-level engineering entrance exams alongside your regular school syllabus.
steps.requirement: Consistent daily study habit of 4-6 hours

steps.title: Appear for Engineering Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Take national exams like JEE Main and JEE Advanced, alongside state-level CETs and private university entrance tests to maximize your college admission options.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech / B.E. Degree
steps.detail: Enroll in a 4-year Bachelor of Technology program in a high-demand specialization like Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, or Core Engineering.
steps.requirement: Valid score in JEE or other engineering entrance tests

steps.title: Campus Placements or Higher Studies
steps.detail: Secure a software or core engineering job through college placement cells, or prepare for GATE / CAT / foreign master's programs based on your career goals.
steps.requirement: B.Tech degree completion with a strong CGPA

fwd:10th:any.commonMistake: Neglecting board exam preparation while blindly chasing coaching institute problem sets, which can result in failing the 75% eligibility criteria required for top engineering colleges.

fwd:10th:math & logic.title: Data Science & Artificial Intelligence Engineer Roadmap
fwd:10th:math & logic.summary: For a student strong in math and logic after Class 10, entering the Science stream with Mathematics paves the way for top engineering degrees in Computer Science, specialized in AI and Data Science.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCM with Computer Science)
steps.detail: Enroll in Higher Secondary (CBSE/ICSE/State Board) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM), along with Computer Science or Information Practices as an elective. Focus heavily on strengthening calculus, algebra, and probability, which form the bedrock of machine learning and logic.
steps.requirement: Minimum 75% aggregate in Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Appear for Engineering Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Prepare for national and state-level engineering entrance exams during Class 11 and 12. Aim for high percentile scores in JEE Main to secure admission into premier institutes like IITs, NITs, IIITs, or top state engineering colleges.
steps.requirement: Passing Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics

steps.title: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in CSE / AI & Data Science
steps.detail: Pursue a 4-year B.Tech degree focusing on core computer science subjects, discrete mathematics, data structures, and algorithms. Build a strong foundation in programming languages like Python and C++ during the initial semesters.
steps.requirement: Qualifying JEE Main/Advanced or State CETs

steps.title: Specialization, Internships, and Capstone Projects
steps.detail: Take advanced electives in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Big Data. Secure summer internships at tech startups or established firms to apply theoretical logic to real-world datasets.
steps.requirement: Maintaining a strong CGPA and active GitHub portfolio

steps.title: Entry-Level Role or M.Tech Specialization
steps.detail: Enter the workforce directly as a Junior Data Analyst, Machine Learning Engineer, or Software Developer. Alternatively, clear GATE to pursue an M.Tech or specialized Master's for advanced research and leadership roles.
steps.requirement: B.Tech degree and practical project portfolio

fwd:10th:math & logic.commonMistake: Neglecting practical programming and coding practice while solely focusing on theoretical mathematics taught in textbooks.

fwd:10th:science & experiments.title: Science Stream to Engineering/Research Track
fwd:10th:science & experiments.summary: This pathway focuses on Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) leading to core engineering, technology, or pure science research careers in India.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCM)
steps.detail: Enroll in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with Computer Science or Biology as an elective. Build strong conceptual foundations to prepare for upcoming national-level entrance examinations.
steps.requirement: Minimum 75% aggregate in Class 10 Board exams recommended for top coaching and eligibility criteria.

steps.title: Appear for Engineering Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Register and appear for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, BITSAT, and state-level engineering entrance tests (like MHT-CET or KCET).
steps.requirement: Passing Class 12 board exams with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Biology/Computer Science.

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech / B.E. or Integrated B.Sc-M.Sc
steps.detail: Secure admission into an IIT, NIT, IIIT, or reputed private engineering college based on entrance scores. Focus on hands-on lab experiments, coding, and core domain projects.
steps.requirement: Valid score in JEE Main/Advanced or university-specific entrance tests.

steps.title: Internships & Skill Development
steps.detail: Take up summer research fellowships (like IAS-INSA-NASI) or industry internships to gain practical exposure and experiment with real-world applications.
steps.requirement: Maintaining a strong CGPA (typically above 7.5/10) during undergraduate years.

steps.title: Higher Studies or Core R&D Job
steps.detail: Choose between entering the core tech/engineering workforce directly or appearing for GATE for an M.Tech, or GRE/TOEFL for studying abroad (MS/PhD).
steps.requirement: B.Tech/B.E. degree completion; valid GATE score for Indian Master's programs.

fwd:10th:science & experiments.commonMistake: Neglecting NCERT textbooks and conceptual clarity in favor of blindly memorizing formulas for coaching institute tests.

fwd:10th:business & money.title: Chartered Accountancy & Finance Pathway
fwd:10th:business & money.summary: This pathway leverages an early interest in business and money by steering you into Commerce with Mathematics in Class 11-12, setting you up for top finance degrees or professional qualifications like Chartered Accountancy.

steps.title: Choose Commerce Stream with Mathematics
steps.detail: Enroll in CBSE, ICSE, or State Board taking Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, and Applied Mathematics or Mathematics. Strong foundational basics here will make college entrance exams and professional courses significantly easier.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60-70% aggregate in Class 10 board exams.

steps.title: Ace Boards and Prepare for Entrances
steps.detail: Focus heavily on scoring high percentages in your Class 12 board exams while simultaneously studying for central university entrance tests and professional foundation exams.
steps.requirement: Above 85% aggregate recommended for top-tier commerce colleges.

steps.title: Pursue B.Com (Hons) or BMS / BBA
steps.detail: Get into a premier institution like SRCC, St. Xavier's, or Loyola for a Bachelor of Commerce or Management degree. Use these three years to build practical Excel skills and understand corporate finance.
steps.requirement: Clear CUET or college-specific entrance tests.

steps.title: Register for CA Foundation or CFA
steps.detail: If targeting Chartered Accountancy, clear the CA Foundation right after Class 12 and Intermediate during college. Alternatively, prepare for global certifications like CFA Level 1 during your final year of graduation.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass certificate for CA Foundation.

steps.title: Articleship or Specialized Master's (MBA)
steps.detail: Complete your mandatory 2-year CA articleship under a chartered accountant firm, or work for 2-3 years before cracking the CAT exam to pursue an MBA in Finance from top IIMs.
steps.requirement: Clear CA Intermediate and Finals, or CAT for MBA.

steps.title: Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, or Auditing
steps.detail: Step into roles such as Financial Analyst, Investment Banking Associate, Tax Consultant, or Corporate Auditor with top MNCs or Big 4 accounting firms.
steps.requirement: Completed professional degree (CA/MBA/CFA).

fwd:10th:business & money.commonMistake: Ignoring Mathematics in Class 11 assuming commerce doesn't need it, which severely limits future options in finance, analytics, and top-tier management entrances.

fwd:10th:art & design.title: Design Career Pathway (B.Des)
fwd:10th:art & design.summary: This pathway guides a student from Class 10 through the Humanities or Science stream into top Indian design schools via national entrance exams for a Bachelor of Design (B.Des) degree.

steps.title: Choose Stream and Build Fundamentals
steps.detail: Opt for any stream (Humanities, Science, or Commerce) based on your school availability, though Humanities or Science with Computer Science helps. Dedicate time to building sketching skills, visual observation, spatial awareness, and a basic design portfolio.
steps.requirement: Complete Class 10 with minimum 50% aggregate

steps.title: Appear for Class 12 Boards and Design Entrances
steps.detail: Prepare concurrently for Class 12 board exams and national-level design entrance tests like NIFT, NID DAT, and UCEED. Focus on creative ability, logical reasoning, and general knowledge alongside your regular board studies.
steps.requirement: Class 12 passing certificate from a recognized board

steps.title: Clear Design Entrance Exams (NID, NIFT, UCEED)
steps.detail: Crack the two-tier exams: Prelims (Creative Ability Test and General Ability Test) followed by Mains (Studio Test and Personal Interview). Securing a high rank ensures admission into premier institutes like NID Ahmedabad, top NIFT campuses, or IIT Bombay/Guwahati for B.Des.
steps.requirement: Valid score in NID DAT, NIFT, or UCEED

steps.title: Pursue Bachelor of Design (B.Des)
steps.detail: Complete a 4-year professional B.Des program specializing in Industrial Design, Communication Design, Fashion Design, Interaction Design, or Textile Design. Engage in live projects, material workshops, and collaborative studios.
steps.requirement: Admission into a 4-year B.Des program

steps.title: Internships and Graduation Project
steps.detail: Secure industry internships during semester breaks and execute a comprehensive capstone graduation project. Build a robust digital portfolio showcasing your problem-solving process and design prototypes.
steps.requirement: Completion of core coursework

steps.title: Entry-Level Design Roles or Higher Studies
steps.detail: Enter the industry as a UX/UI Designer, Product Designer, Graphic Designer, or Fashion Stylist through campus placements or portfolio applications. Alternatively, prepare for M.Des via CEED for specialized master's training.
steps.requirement: B.Des Degree and a professional portfolio

examsToWatch: UCEED (Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design)
fwd:10th:art & design.commonMistake: Treating design entrances purely as art exams; top design schools look for analytical thinking, empathy, and problem-solving skills rather than just beautiful sketching.

fwd:10th:writing & communication.title: Journalism & Mass Communication Roadmap
fwd:10th:writing & communication.summary: A structured career path tailored for a Class 10 graduate passionate about writing and communication, leading to dynamic roles in media, content creation, and corporate communications.

steps.title: Build a Strong Foundation in Arts
steps.detail: Choose the Humanities/Arts stream with subjects like English, Political Science, History, and Psychology to enhance critical thinking, reading comprehension, and expression. Focus on scoring well in English while starting a personal blog or school magazine to hone writing skills.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50-60% aggregate in Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Appear for Media Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Prepare for national and university-level entrance tests for journalism and mass communication right after your Class 12 board exams. Keep backup options open by registering for CUET for central universities offering BA in Journalism.
steps.requirement: Passed Class 12 from any recognized board (CBSE/ICSE/State) with English as a core subject

steps.title: Pursue BA in Journalism & Mass Communication (BAJMC)
steps.detail: Enroll in a reputed 3-year BAJMC or B.A. (Hons) English program. Learn the fundamentals of reporting, media ethics, digital storytelling, video editing, and public relations while contributing actively to college fests and student publications.
steps.requirement: Qualify entrance tests like IIMC, CUET, or institute-specific tests like XIC, Symbiosis (SET)

steps.title: Secure Internships and Freelance Gigs
steps.detail: Utilize college semesters and summer breaks to intern with digital media houses, newspapers, PR agencies, or corporate content teams. Build a robust digital portfolio showcasing published articles, blog posts, or video scripts.
steps.requirement: Basic proficiency in writing tools, WordPress, and social media platforms

steps.title: Specialize or Enter the Workforce
steps.detail: Choose to either enter the industry directly as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Junior Journalist, or pursue a specialized PG diploma in advertising, broadcast journalism, or corporate communications to accelerate career growth.
steps.requirement: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a strong writing portfolio

examsToWatch: IIMC Entrance Exam (Indian Institute of Mass Communication)
SET (Symbiosis Entrance Test for Mass Communication)
XIC OET (Xavier Institute of Communications Online Entrance Test)
ACJ Entrance Exam (Asian College of Journalism)
fwd:10th:writing & communication.commonMistake: Ignoring the technical side of modern media—relying solely on traditional writing skills without learning SEO, basic video editing, content analytics, and digital publishing tools.

fwd:10th:people & helping others.title: Roadmap to Healthcare & Medicine via PCB Stream
fwd:10th:people & helping others.summary: For a student passionate about helping people, pursuing the Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) opens the door to impactful careers in medicine, allied health, and psychological counseling.

steps.title: Choose Science (PCB) Stream
steps.detail: Enroll in CBSE, ICSE, or State Board with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English. Focus heavily on mastering Biology and Chemistry concepts as they form the bedrock of healthcare professions.
steps.requirement: Minimum 50% aggregate in Class 10 with a strong inclination toward science

steps.title: Qualify Senior Secondary Board Exams
steps.detail: Maintain a high academic standing in your board exams while simultaneously preparing for medical entrance tests. Most professional health science courses require a minimum aggregate of 50% in PCB subjects.
steps.requirement: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English

steps.title: Appear for National & State Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Register for NEET-UG, which is the mandatory gateway for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, and nursing courses in India. For psychology or social work paths, prepare for university entrance tests via CUET.
steps.requirement: NEET-UG registration and eligibility criteria fulfillment

steps.title: Pursue MBBS, Nursing, or Psychology
steps.detail: Complete your professional undergraduate degree. For MBBS, this involves 4.5 years of coursework followed by a mandatory 1-year rotatory internship in a hospital setting.
steps.requirement: Qualifying score in NEET-UG or CUET

steps.title: Specialize or Enter Healthcare Practice
steps.detail: Pursue an MD/MS for medical specialization, a Master's in Psychology for counseling roles, or gain direct employment in hospitals, NGOs, and community health organizations.
steps.requirement: Completion of undergraduate degree and relevant entrance tests like NEET-PG

fwd:10th:people & helping others.commonMistake: Neglecting Physics and Chemistry while focusing solely on Biology, which severely hurts performance in competitive entrance exams like NEET.

fwd:10th:computers & tech.title: Computer Science Engineering Roadmap
fwd:10th:computers & tech.summary: This path guides a student passionate about technology from Class 10 through the Science-Math stream into a premier engineering degree and a career in software development.

steps.title: Choose Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM) with Computer Science
steps.detail: Enroll in a recognized board (CBSE/ICSE/State) with PCM and Computer Science or Information Practices. Focus heavily on strengthening your core mathematics and logical thinking, while beginning to learn coding languages like Python or C++.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60% aggregate in Class 10 board exams

steps.title: Appear for Engineering Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Prepare for national and state-level engineering entrances alongside your Class 12 board exams. Dedicate consistent hours to solving previous years' question papers for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and relevant state CETs.
steps.requirement: Minimum 75% aggregate in Class 12 for top-tier institutes (NITs/IIITs/IITs)

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
steps.detail: Secure admission into a B.Tech or B.E. program in Computer Science. Focus on foundational subjects like Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, and Database Management Systems.
steps.requirement: Valid score in JEE Main, JEE Advanced, or State CETs

steps.title: Skill Development and Internships
steps.detail: Build real-world software projects, participate in coding platforms (LeetCode, Codeforces), and secure summer internships in tech companies. Specialise in domains like AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or Full-Stack Development based on your interest.
steps.requirement: Active GitHub profile and practical coding portfolio

steps.title: Campus Placements or Higher Studies
steps.detail: Secure a role as a Software Engineer through campus placements or off-campus drives. Alternatively, prepare for GATE if you wish to pursue an M.Tech or higher specialization from premier institutes.
steps.requirement: B.Tech degree in Computer Science

fwd:10th:computers & tech.commonMistake: Neglecting core Mathematics and focusing solely on syntax-based coding during Class 11 and 12, which makes cracking tough engineering entrance exams and core computer science concepts difficult later.

fwd:10th:not sure yet.title: Science (PCM) & Engineering Roadmap
fwd:10th:not sure yet.summary: Since the student is undecided after Class 10, choosing the Science PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) stream keeps the maximum number of career options open, ranging from engineering and architecture to aviation, defense, and pure sciences.

steps.title: Choose Science Stream (PCM + English + Optional)
steps.detail: Enroll in CBSE, ICSE, or State Board with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Select an optional subject like Computer Science, Economics, or Physical Education, and maintain a strong aggregate above 75% to meet eligibility criteria for higher education and entrance exams.
steps.requirement: Minimum 60-70% in Class 10 board exams, especially in Mathematics and Science

steps.title: Build Foundational Aptitude for Entrances
steps.detail: Begin balanced preparation for competitive exams alongside board studies. Focus heavily on conceptual clarity in physics, problem-solving in mathematics, and physical chemistry to ease the transition into rigorous entrance exam coaching.
steps.requirement: Consistent daily study habit of 2-3 hours

steps.title: Clear Board Exams with Strong Scores
steps.detail: Focus on scoring well in board examinations. Many premier technical institutes and centralized counselling processes require a minimum aggregate percentage (often 75% for JEE Advanced) or top 20 percentile in respective board exams.
steps.requirement: Passing Class 12 board exams with required board-specific percentages

steps.title: Appear for Engineering & National Entrance Exams
steps.detail: Take national and state-level entrance tests like JEE Main, JEE Advanced, BITSAT, or state CETs to secure admission into top-tier technology institutes for a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) degree.
steps.requirement: Valid scorecards in respective national or state entrance exams

steps.title: Pursue B.Tech / B.E. and Explore Specializations
steps.detail: Complete the 4-year engineering degree. Utilize the first two years to explore diverse fields like Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Mechanical, or Civil engineering before locking down internships and final placements.
steps.requirement: Admission into an AICTE-approved engineering college

steps.title: Placement, Higher Studies, or Civil Services
steps.detail: Choose between campus placements for corporate roles, preparing for GATE for an M.Tech, taking the CAT for an MBA, or appearing for UPSC Civil Services examinations, leveraging the rigorous analytical foundation built during engineering.
steps.requirement: Successful completion of B.Tech degree with a competitive CGPA

fwd:10th:not sure yet.commonMistake: Falling behind in Class 11 Mathematics and Physics, which creates massive conceptual backlog and makes clearing competitive entrance exams extremely difficult by Class 12.

fwd:12th:any.title: General Graduation via CUET & Corporate Career
fwd:12th:any.summary: Since no specific stream or interest was provided, pursuing a versatile Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) or Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) through the Common University Entrance Test (CUET) offers the widest range of flexibility to explore diverse career options.

steps.title: Reflect and Prepare for CUET
steps.detail: Since you have just finished Class 12, focus on preparing for the CUET exam to secure admission into top central and state universities for general graduation degrees.
steps.requirement: Class 12 pass certificate

steps.title: Explore Electives and Skills
steps.detail: Enroll in a versatile undergraduate program like B.Com, B.A. (Economics/Political Science), or BBA. Use the first year to explore subjects, join college societies, and build basic computer and communication skills.
steps.requirement: Admission via CUET or merit

steps.title: Internships and Certifications
